result.method: 5000 seeded overlapping two-UTC-date block resamples of paired totals and counts
result.limitations: Inference mechanics only. Callers must authenticate original grid/coverage, units, features, raw sources, temporal release and enrollment. Nominal percentile coverage is not guaranteed under long dependence or nonstationarity. No production calibration is inferred.

scope: Deliberately constructed less-bad but still losing candidate; no market data or alpha result
